name: Mighty NAM RAM transfer
framing: private complete binary frames, no BLE/HID implementation

fields.5: op: hello1 begin2 data3 commit4 abort5 status6; reply=op|0x80
fields.20:24: CRC32 IEEE of first20 header bytes

reply_payload: six uint32: status, received bytes, committed-slot CRC32, slot size8192, max chunk256, capabilities3 (A2 Lite + RAM only)
begin_payload: uint32 slot-size8192 + uint32 whole-slot CRC32; same begin retransmission does not reset offset
commit: Validate full transfer CRC, slot header, inner weight CRC, finite weights and FF padding; copy staging to active RAM. Idempotent for last committed session. Does not switch a running DSP.
activation: Caller stops audio and serializes receiver/DSP access, then calls load_active(engine,true). No live-target scheduler or binding yet.
cancellation: Abort staging only; committed bank remains. Reset clears both RAM banks; phone retransfer required.
limits: CRC32 is corruption detection, not authentication. SHA256 is recorded by app as model identity, not a receiver-side cryptographic check.
No persistent storage, target addresses, erase, reboot, DFU, USB or BLE operations.
No claimed support for stock firmware. A custom authenticated/identified transport and MIDI packing/fragmentation are future work.
No linked hardware image or proven real-time target performance.
